core_finding.pt: O PCDT nacional do SUS e o posicionamento clínico atual SBN/SBPC-ML não utilizam a mesma geração da equação CKD-EPI. A divergência deve ser explicitada.
core_finding.en: The national SUS PCDT and the current SBN/SBPC-ML clinical position do not use the same CKD-EPI generation. The divergence must be explicit.

national_sus_pcdt.authority: Ministério da Saúde / SAES / SECTICS / CONITEC
national_sus_pcdt.title: PCDT das Estratégias para Atenuar a Progressão da Doença Renal Crônica
national_sus_pcdt.pcdt_recommendation: Use serum-creatinine-based CKD-EPI to estimate GFR.
national_sus_pcdt.pcdt_cited_equation_source: Levey AS et al. Ann Intern Med. 2009;150:604-612.

authorities: Sociedade Brasileira de Patologia Clínica/Medicina Laboratorial (SBPC/ML)
brazilian_specialty_consensus.title: Estimativa da taxa de filtração glomerular na prática clínica: posicionamento consensual SBN e SBPC/ML
brazilian_specialty_consensus.race_correction_position: Do not use race correction in preferred adult eGFR equations.
brazilian_specialty_consensus.clinical_significance: The consensus states that race correction can overestimate kidney function and delay diagnosis, dialysis/transplant-related care and other decisions.

erratum.correction: Corrected the CKD-EPI 2021 max(creatinine/k,1) exponent from +1.200 to -1.200.
erratum.current_engine_alignment: Clinical Reference Hub already uses -1.200 and therefore matches the corrected equation.

verified_source_conflicts.software_rule: Do not implement the literal PCDT rendering.

verified_source_conflicts.cited_2009_equation: Switch is sex-specific: >0.7 mg/dL female, >0.9 mg/dL male.
verified_source_conflicts.software_rule: Do not implement a universal 0.7 mg/dL switch.

verified_source_conflicts.ambiguity: Exactly 300 mg/g is not textually assigned.
verified_source_conflicts.current_app_rule: A2 includes 300 mg/g; A3 begins above 300 mg/g.
verified_source_conflicts.software_rule: Do not change the current exact-300 boundary until policy reconciliation is documented.

verified_source_conflicts.pcdt_position: 2009 CKD-EPI table includes race-dependent A constants.
verified_source_conflicts.software_rule: Never silently replace the existing race-free CKD-EPI 2021 calculation with a race-based equation.

aki_brazil_alignment.ministry_source: Linha de Cuidado da Doença Renal Crônica em adultos

bh2b_implementation_rules: Preserve CKD-EPI 2021 race-free as the current clinical/default equation.
Identify CKD-EPI 2021 as aligned with the 2024 SBN/SBPC-ML Brazilian consensus.
Expose the national SUS PCDT separately as policy context rather than silently replacing the default.
Do not implement the PCDT equation literally while its displayed formula conflicts with its cited source.
Do not ask the application to infer race from phenotype, name, geography or any other proxy.
Preserve international KDIGO 2024 G/A classification and provide the SUS PCDT staging view separately.
Preserve current AKI calculations and add explicit Brazil Ministry/KDIGO-2012 provenance.
Keep all Brazil/international distinctions bilingual and available offline.
